8-23-23
The insured reported a hit while turning left at an intersection, with the other vehicle striking the rear quarter of the
claimant's car. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all contact is being routed through the attorney's office
going forward.
9-1-23
Photos from the scene and the other driver's statement line up with the reported impact, and the damage on the
claimant's vehicle is consistent with a side-to-rear collision of this kind. Two independent witnesses describe the
same sequence of events.
11-28-23
Police records and the witnesses both place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. The driver is listed
on the policy, and no earlier damage to the vehicle has come to light; nothing in the file suggests the damage
predates the coverage start.
11-29-23
The claimant reports lower back strain and has been treating with a physician. The reported injury is a plausible result
of a collision of this type, and there is no record of prior trouble in that body area.
1-25-24
Treatment has followed a typical course, with therapy visits tapering as the claimant's mobility and pain improved.
Medical notes are consistent with the progress the claimant describes.
2-9-24
The claimant's account of the accident has stayed the same across every call, written statement and meeting with the
adjuster, with no material differences in the details.
2-11-24
Based on the consistent evidence, the claim is moving fowrard on the liability and injury components, with counsel
copied on the next status letter and a reserve review scheduled.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
